title: GOD WILL GUARD WHAT YOU LEAVE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'Celebrate the Festival of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Ingathering at the turn of the year. Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord, the God of Israel. I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the Lord your God.'" - Exod 34:22-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Consider what God was asking. Three times a year, every man in Israel was to leave his farm, his home and his family and travel to worship. In a land surrounded by hostile neighbours, that meant leaving everything undefended.

And God's answer to the obvious anxiety is simply: no one will covet your land. I will take care of what you leave behind.

This was a specific promise to Israel in their land, and we should not turn it into a guarantee that God will protect our property whenever we go to church. But the character of God behind it does not change. He does not ask us to obey Him and then leave us to absorb the cost alone.

Every act of obedience has a cost. Time given to God is time not given elsewhere. Money given away is money not kept. Honesty at work may cost promotion. And every time, the same question arises: can I trust Him with what this costs me?

Jesus addressed exactly this fear. Seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well (Matt 6:33). Your Father knows what you need.

You cannot outgive God, and you cannot lose by obeying Him.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What does obedience currently cost you?
2. What are you afraid to leave in God's hands?
3. Where do you need to seek His kingdom first this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I bring You my fears about what obedience costs. Help me to trust You with what I cannot control. Amen.
